small_guidance:
- The inner loop multiplies BLOCK_P by POOL*POOL spatial reads per (ic,kh,kw); try shrinking BLOCK_P to 16 and bumping BLOCK_OC to 128 with num_warps=8 to raise OC reuse of each loaded x tile, since x reads dominate. Also add configs with BLOCK_P=8, BLOCK_OC=128.
- Fold the 1/(POOL*POOL) factor into the weight tile once before the accumulation loop (wv *= inv_pool2) instead of scaling the full pooled_acc afterwards — trivial, but removes one vector op on a [BLOCK_OC,BLOCK_P] tile.
- Currently each (dy,dx) within a (kh,kw) reloads neighboring input pixels redundantly across kh/kw; reorder loops so the outer loop is over ic and the conv+pool window is a single (KH+POOL-1)×(KW+POOL-1) patch loaded once per ic per output tile, then reduced with the KH×KW weights — large reuse win without changing arithmetic count.
large_guidance:
- Rewrite as an implicit-GEMM conv where M=OC, N=N*PH*PW (pooled output positions), K=IC*KH*KW, with each program computing a BLOCK_M×BLOCK_N tile and, in the epilogue, summing the POOL×POOL conv outputs that map to one pooled position (4 K-loop micro-accumulators per N-lane, or compute conv at full OH×OW resolution in registers and reduce). Apply *1/POOL², add bias, sigmoid, then a block-level reduction across (OC, PH*PW) in shared memory and one atomic_add per program to out[n]. This gives proper K-dimension tiling (currently K is a fully-unrolled static_range of size IC*KH*KW=72) and tensor-core-friendly tl.dot.
- Use channels-last (NHWC) input + (KH,KW,IC,OC) weight layout so the K reduction (IC inside the (kh,kw) loop) is the contiguous axis and loads coalesce; this is the dominant memory-traffic optimization for IC=8 where the current NCHW layout makes IC stride = H*W.
- Make the kernel persistent over the (N, OC-tile) axis and accumulate the per-image scalar sum in registers across all PH*PW tiles, doing a single tl.atomic_add (or even a plain store after a grid-level reduction across OC tiles) per image instead of one atomic per (oc-tile, p-tile) program — reduces atomic contention on out[n] which is currently N*ceil(OC/BLOCK_OC)*ceil(PHPW/BLOCK_P) atomics per image.
